''See also: [[Capital (The Elder Empire: Sea) Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|The Capital is a massive, sprawling city that serves as the central seat of the [[Elder Empire]]. It is so expansive that it covers a significant portion of the coastline, stretching far to both the north and south. The city is characterized by a constant atmosphere of smoke and the chaotic, continuous ringing of thousands of bells. Within its borders lies the [[Imperial]] Palace, a massive complex that functions as its own city and houses tens of thousands of people. The Capital also contains a [[Navigator chapter house]], a large structure constructed from the remains of old ships, featuring masts and porthole windows. Historically, the area has functioned as a hub for culture, a refuge for those fleeing conflict, and a location for businesses that cannot operate within the city itself. The city is protected by harbor-guns and contains a high concentration of statues designed to amplify [[Reading]] as part of the [[Optasia]] system. It serves as the political heart of The Empire{{!}}the Empire, housing the [[throne]] that represents imperial Authority{{!}}authority.}}

== Of Sea and Shadow ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow|The Capital is a city defined by its gleaming clock-towers, ancient spires, and a light that night cannot conquer. Within its borders lie various [[Imperial]] homes and wealthy districts, all supported by the resources of the [[Imperial]] Palace which fund both city operations and the [[Imperial Guard]]. Following the death of the Emperor, the city was swallowed by several months of chaos.}}

== Of Dawn and Darkness ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness|The Capital is a vast city that swallows the coastline and can be approached by sea. Mentioned as a destination by Andel Petronus{{!}}Andel, it is a location that Bliss of the Blackwatch{{!}}Bliss intends to return to. The city's population has been acclimated to the concept of a leader for many years, and its society includes an upper crust of influential people. Within the city, prisoners face trial and [[Kanatalia]] workshops are located. Additionally, the [[Consultants]] were scheduled to be escorted back to this location.}}

== Of Kings and Killers ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|The Capital experienced a massive surge in population during the coronation, though its military harbor remains small in comparison to [[Candle Bay]]. The city is home to a [[Navigator chapter house]] and an [[Imperial]] Palace that occupies nearly twenty percent of the urban area, all while remaining visible through a rift in the void. Although Bliss of the Blackwatch{{!}}Bliss attempted to transport herself directly to the location, the city is characterized by its bell tower rooftop, [[sunset-orange quicklamps]] that light the streets at night, and a high concentration of [[Optasia]] statues. During a period of intense chaos, champions were found dead throughout the streets and citizens screamed as the [[Imperial]] Palace fell. Amidst this turmoil, [[Calder]] flew back through the city and appeared in a vision sitting upon a [[throne]] at its center. Despite the unrest, the Capital remains protected by wards against the [[Elders]] and can be shielded by the [[White Sun]].}}
